articles.title: Karnataka education department asks KSOU to defer event on RSS ideologue
articles.summary: The Election Commission (EC) released its first supplementary list of voters for West Bengal, adding 29 lakh individuals. Made available past midnight, this crucial update ensures electoral rolls are comprehensive and up-to-date. This significant exercise by the EC reflects ongoing efforts to prepare for upcoming elections and maintain democratic integrity within the nation, crucial for aspirant awareness.

articles.title: EC waits till midnight to release first supplementary list of 29 lakh Bengal voters
articles.summary: A jury found prominent entertainer Bill Cosby liable for drugging and sexually assaulting a woman, awarding the victim USD 19 million. This civil verdict underscores ongoing legal accountability for high-profile figures. Aspiring officers should note how such international cases reflect evolving societal standards and the persistence of justice in challenging circumstances.

articles.title: 114 Rafales, 60 MTA aircraft, AEW&C deals to be concluded in 2026-27: Defence ministry to parl panel
articles.summary: India's Defence Ministry announced to a parliamentary panel that significant procurement deals are expected to conclude by 2026-27. These include 114 Rafale fighter jets, 60 Medium Transport Aircraft (MTA), and new Airborne Early Warning & Control (AEW&C) systems. This strategic move aims to bolster India's air power, lift capabilities, and aerial surveillance for enhanced national security.

articles.title: Over half dozen Navy warships escorting Indian-flagged vessels in Gulf region
articles.summary: The Indian Navy has deployed over half a dozen warships near the Gulf region to safely escort fuel tankers bound for India. This strategic deployment aims to ensure the unhindered flow of critical energy supplies and protect India's maritime trade interests amidst potential regional instability. It underscores the Navy's commitment to safeguarding national energy security.

articles.title: War Gaming at the Naval War College—Then and Now
articles.summary: During the interwar period, war gaming served as a principal educational tool for military and security establishments. This historical practice was vital in shaping strategic thinking and determining America's global role. For SSB aspirants, understanding such historical methodologies highlights the importance of strategic foresight and continuous learning in defence planning, underscoring how past military education influences contemporary security preparedness and national strategy.

articles.title: PM Modi not just a person but an idea, institution: Shivraj
articles.summary: Former Madhya Pradesh CM Shivraj Singh Chouhan lauded Prime Minister Narendra Modi, stating that PM Modi transcends being merely an individual, representing an idea and an institution. This statement emphasizes Modi's profound influence on Indian governance and national identity, positioning him as a guiding force beyond a singular personality, a sentiment often echoed by leaders within the ruling party.
